requiredBehaviors.evidence: Phase 0 requires round-based-requirements-grilling and consumes the confirmed GRILL-REPORT/requirements handoff.
Phase 2 delegates journal normalization to thought-capture-journal while preserving raw text and time context.
Phase 3 delegates semantic extraction to thought-graph-extractor with sourceRefs, confidence and contradiction preservation.
The presentation projection explicitly includes dramaturgy, core messages, audience effect, visuals, timing, transitions and Q&A.
Phase 4 defines both Obsidian Universe/Vault and Mermaid rendering paths.
